artifact_observations.reasoning: The water texture appears slightly smudged and painterly, lacking the crisp, complex detail of real photographic water, particularly in the wake where the foam blends into the water somewhat unnaturally.
Fine details on the wheelhouse windows and railings are soft and lack sharp edges, suggesting either generative blur or low-resolution upscaling artifacts rather than optical depth-of-field blur.
The water cannon on the bow appears slightly fused with the deck railing; the mechanical joints and distinct separation between the nozzle and its mount are indistinct and geometrically ambiguous.
